profile.title: Supplier profile
profile.subtitle: Fill in your lead times, certifications and delivery scope to reassure buyers.

sections.termsHint: Minimum order, lead times and delivery scope shown to buyers.
sections.certificationsHint: Standards and labels you hold (ISO, FSC, OEKO-TEX…).

moderation.pendingHint: Our team is reviewing your organization: your products are not yet guaranteed to be visible.
moderation.approvedHint: Your organization is approved and your catalogue is visible to buyers.
moderation.rejectedHint: Your organization was rejected: your catalogue is no longer visible to buyers.

contacts.title: Sales team
contacts.subtitle: The sales representatives agencies can contact directly, based on their country.
contacts.teamHint: Each agency sees the contacts covering its country; with none for its country, it sees the whole team.
contacts.emptyHint: Add the sales representatives agencies can reach.
contacts.showAll: Show the whole team to every agency
contacts.showAllHint: Agencies see all your contacts, whatever their country.

upsell.title: Contacts are shown for subscribed suppliers only
upsell.body: You can prepare your team now: it will be shown to agencies as soon as you subscribe.

fields.name: Name
fields.countriesHint: No country selected: the contact covers all countries.
fields.memberHint: Optional: link the contact to a user who signs in to the account.
